messages:
Rhea Singh: Quick heads-up 18:00 PT tomorrow we're pushing the benchmark blog + short video. Need press standby and a reactive Q&A ready.
Omar Lewis: On it. I'll monitor press@ and my DMs from 17:30-19:30 PT.
Katherine Wu: Legal reviewed copy; removed a sentence claiming 'best-in-class' and replaced with 'notable reductions'. Also asked we avoid customer names in the excerpt.
Ben Torres: Social plan: 2x posts on X, 1x LinkedIn, engineer thread 45m after publish. Who has the hero clip?
Rhea Singh: Use hero-clip-v5 in the assets folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/bench/hero-clip-v5.mp4. Caption tweak: add "for production LLM workloads" to the first line.
Katherine Wu: Also draft a short embargo-friendly quote for reporters who ask early. Keep it non-specific: avoid numbers and competitor mentions.
Ben Torres: I'll draft a 1-line reactive quote and a slightly longer FAQ paragraph for the blog. Posting drafts in the PR folder now.
press-bot: Embargo set: 2025-11-19T18:00:00-08:00. Auto-hold on scheduled posts until manual resume.
Omar Lewis: Flag: one partner who received preview assets just emailed saying they'll syndicate. Marcus from partners requested hold. Can someone message him?
Rhea Singh: I messaged Marcus. Please pause partner syndication; we'll coordinate after publish.
Katherine Wu: Reactive language here: "Our published benchmarks reflect internal workload mixes; full methodology is available on publish and we9d be happy to provide details to reporters." Approve?
Ben Torres: Approve. Adding to the media kit and saving a short version for DMs.
Omar Lewis: Received an advance ask from a reporter for a 'teaser stat' 00 words. Legal says no. I'll offer the reactive line and offer follow-up after publish.
Rhea Singh: Ops note: use #press-watch during the hour. If any pickup before embargo, escalate to @exec-comm and call Katherine.
press-bot: Publish job created: job-id=pb-2025-1119-18. Status=scheduled.
Ben Torres: Social queued but held by bot. I'll stand by to hit resume when I get the green light from Rhea.
Katherine Wu: Final check: remove raw customer references in the case snippet and replace with 'early adopters'. I pushed the change to the draft.
Rhea Singh: Thanks. Final sign-off check at 17:30 PT tomorrow in this thread. If no objections by then, we proceed with 18:00 PT publish.
Omar Lewis: I'll monitor and post any inbound interest here.
press-bot: Reminder set for 17:25 PT for final sign-off.
